info.name: Sonatype Lifecycle Public REST Advanced Search Application Report Data API

params.name: applicationPublicId
params.description: Enter the applicationPublicId, created at the time of creating the application

params.name: fromCommit
params.description: Enter the commit hash linked to the earlier policy evaluation.

params.name: toCommit
params.description: Enter the commit hash linked to the other (later) policy evaluation to compare.

params.name: fromPolicyEvaluationId
params.description: Enter the policy evaluation Id linked to the earlier policy evaluation to compare

params.name: toPolicyEvaluationId
params.description: Enter the policy evaluation Id linked to the other (later) policy evaluation to compare

params.name: includeViolationTimes
params.description: Set to true to include policy violation times (open, legacy, waived, fixed) in the response if set.

items.docs:
By configuring Lifecycle with SCM, policy evaluations can be linked to the Git commit hash. Use this method to compare the violations between policy evaluations for 2 commits, by providing the linked commit hashes.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements

params.name: applicationPublicId
params.description: Enter the applicationPublicId for the evaluated application.

params.name: scanId
params.description: Enter the scanId (reportId) of the application report created after the evaluation.

items.docs: This is an older version of the endpoint. This call will now be redirected to /api/v2/applications/{applicationPublicId}/reports/{scanId}/raw.

params.name: applicationPublicId

items.docs:
Use this method to retrieve the dependencies related to the component identified at the time of application evaluation. This is currently available only for Java (Maven) and NPM applications.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements
